caption: The drawing depicts a tall, free-standing grandfather clock positioned at the center of a plain, cream-colored background. The clock is primarily rendered in shades of brown, resembling polished wood, with darker brown and golden accents outlining the panels and decorative borders. The clock face, which is white with black Roman numerals, is encased in a rectangular upper section topped with an arch that includes three finial ornaments. Gold and silver details are used for the clock’s hands and decorative elements around the face. The body of the clock is rectangular and vertically oriented, with an oval panel in the middle section and additional gold detailing on the door and hardware. The base is wider, with rectangular inlays bordered by gold. At the top left and right corners of the drawing, there are two oval cartouches; the left one contains an image of a winged figure with a shield, and the right one features a bowl with stylized plant forms, both depicted in earthy tones of green, brown, and beige. The objects are set against an otherwise blank background that emphasizes the central placement and vertical orientation of the clock.
title: Grandfather Clock
